results.title: 9 new health centres to be set up in Haryana
results.description: The Haryana Government has approved the opening of nine new Sub-Health Centres and the upgradation of one existing Sub-Health Centre into a Primary Health Centre (PHC). Health Minister Arti Singh Rao said CM has accorded approval for the expansion of the state’s rural healthcare network with Nuh district set to receive seven of the nine [...]
